notes: No training was rerun; this script only pairs existing per-seed metrics with the same-seed EX7 MLP-ge4x comparator.

Ablation time compares direct model fit with MLP fit; stage-OOF pipeline time includes 3-fold OOF generation, base fit, the additional stage-logit extraction pass, and corrector fit. The stage-logit extra pass was timed by replaying existing fold checkpoints without retraining.
The recursive base-only comparison excludes any post-hoc OOF correction.
